import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    q = x / y
    best = abs(q)
    p = 0.0
    s = 1.0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        base = q * i
        for numerator in (math.floor(base), math.ceil(base)):
            distance = abs(q - numerator / i)
            if distance < best:
                p = numerator
                s = i
                best = distance
    print(f"{int(p)}/{int(s)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
